test_run_in_graph_and_eager_modes: test the run_in_graph_and_eager_modes decorator to execute a test method in both graph and eager execution modes
test_mock_tf: test the mock_tf context manager to patch TensorFlow API symbols across both tf and tf.compat.v2 aliases
test_mock_fs: test the MockFs class to create an in-memory mock filesystem for tf.io.gfile operations including absolute and GCS paths
test_gcs_access: test the disable_gcs_access and enable_gcs_access context managers to control GCS access during tests
test_mock_kaggle_api: test the mock_kaggle_api context manager to mock the kaggle CLI subprocess calls for dataset downloads
